capabilities: File incoming Telegram messages into notes using ordered filter rules with variables
Download and embed message attachments into a media folder
Answer /tasks commands with tasks due today and in the days ahead
Restrict the bot to an allowlist of Telegram chats
Map topic code words to folders or notes the commands search
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list, so it must be installed manually; desktop-only and needs Obsidian 1.11.0+. The README warns the bot token is stored in plain text in the vault and documents limits (20 MB file cap, no albums grouping, no scheduled pushes, long polling only).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture messages sent from a phone via Telegram or to query due tasks from a chat.

relations.evidence: Tasks are read in the Tasks plugin's emoji format

summary: Telegram bot bridge that files your Telegram messages into vault notes by rules and answers /tasks commands about due tasks.
